_comment: Reference only, not loaded by the build. Copy the 'plugins.updater' block into tauri.conf.json and uncomment tauri-plugin-updater in Cargo.toml when the owner picks a release channel and update-artifact host. Requires: `tauri-plugin-updater` init in src/lib.rs, a signing keypair from `npx tauri signer generate`, and CI producing a signed latest.json per target. See docs/RELEASING.md.
